concepts.gloss_en: Clapping of hands (as a spiritual practice; the general act)

members.note: representative; general act of clapping used to nullify alien thoughts, sweeten judgments, cancel dispute

concepts.gloss_en: Clapping of hands during prayer (the act specifically qualified as occurring in prayer)

members.note: adds the qualifier 'in prayer' (מחאת כף בשעת התפלה); a specified sub-context of clapping tied to arousing 'wings'/speech and the bed between north and south. Plausibly the same practice but qualified head — keep separate per under-merge rule

notes: The two forms are close (clapping vs. clapping specifically in prayer). Kept separate because the qualifier 'בתפלה' narrows the concept to a specific liturgical context; whether the graph should treat the qualified form as identical to the general act is a human decision.
